sources.title: National Library of Finland catalogue record for Kyösti Julku's reconstruction study of the 1617 Stolbovo boundary
sources.coverage: Specialist historical-geographical reconstruction of the 1617 Stolbovo peace boundary, including maps, from the modern state border to Suolampi
sources.notes: Finna's National Library catalogue identifies Kyösti Julku's 1987 Faravid study specifically as a reconstruction of the 1617 Stolbovo boundary and indexes it under borders and the Stolbovo peace. It is a secondary reconstruction source, not primary treaty cartography, and therefore cannot by itself promote production geometry to geometry-verified.

sources.title: National Archive of the Republic of Tuva public digital corpus for the Tuvan People's Republic
sources.institution: National Archive of the Republic of Tuva
sources.coverage: Digitized Tuvan People's Republic archival holdings, including wartime documents, constitutional material, period newspapers and geographically indexed archival objects
sources.notes: The official regional archive exposes a public catalogue of TNR-era original holdings and a geospatial document index. This locates an authoritative institutional corpus for reconstructing the pre-admission TNR territorial extent, but a specific source-backed 1944 external-boundary polygon still has to be identified and validated before production use.
